name: ~Pantsu o Miseru Koto, Sore ga...~ Daiuchuu no Hokori
original_name: ～パンツを見せること、それが……～大宇宙の誇り
source:
A meteor struck Mamoru when he was a kid, but he didn't get injured at all. That's why he was called "Miracle Meteor Boy". Seven years later, two beautiful girls surrounded by noble aura suddenly captured Mamoru and he was taken to a strange place. Yes, it's inside a spaceship and there he can see even more beautiful girls with their panties exposed as if it's a matter of course...

"Show the Sacred Orb." He doesn't know what are they talking about. According to them, they are alien princesses from the Arcadare planet, and they came to Earth to get the "Sacred Orb", which is a key item of succession battle for the throne. Showing the panties is also a proof of the royal family and the pride of the Great Universe. When they checked Mamoru's body, the Sacred Orb was found dissolved in his body. As a matter of fact, the meteor which struck him was turned out to be the Sacred Orb. And if he do not extract it by his next birthday, then Mamoru will turn into a girl. To get it out, he needs to reach a very strong orgasm. Like this, a battle for the Orb begins...

[Modified from ErogeShop]
translation:
小卫小时候曾被流星击中，但他没有受伤。因此他被称为“奇迹流星男孩”。七年后，两个充满高贵气息的美丽少女突然俘获了阿卫，他被带到了一个陌生的地方。是的，在宇宙飞船里，他可以看到更多的美女，她们的内裤都裸露在外，仿佛这是理所当然的……

“展示圣珠。”他不知道他们在说什么。据她们介绍，她们是来自Arcadare星球的外星公主，来到地球是为了获取王位继承之战的关键物品“圣珠”。露出内裤也是皇室的证明，也是大宇宙的骄傲。当他们检查阿卫的尸体时，发现圣珠溶解在他的体内。事实上，击中他的流星，竟然是圣珠。如果他在下一个生日之前没有取出它，那么Mamoru就会变成一个女孩。为了得到它，他需要达到非常强烈的高潮。就这样，一场争夺宝珠的战斗开始了……
